books/centaur/svl/svex-reduce/integerp-of-svex.lisp: Integer/natp analysis of svex via RP-rewriter with mutual recursion and 200+ 4vec integerp lemmas
books/centaur/svl/svex-reduce/width-of-svex.lisp: Width inference for svex with extensible config, 4vec-correct-width-p theorems, and partsel insertion
books/centaur/svl/svex-simplify-rule-list.lisp: Curated rule-set (350+ entries) and meta-rules for svex-simplify via rp-rewriter
